sentences.1: Controllers have an overriding obligation in Article 35(1) to assess any proposed processing operation against the requirement to complete DPIAs.
sentences.2: The mere fact that the conditions triggering the obligation to carry out DPIA have not been met does not diminish controllers' general obligation to implement measures to appropriately manage risks for the rights and freedoms of data subjects.
sentences.3: The mere fact that the conditions triggering the obligation to carry out DPIA have not been met does not, however, diminish controllers' general obligation to implement measures to appropriately manage risks for the rights and freedoms of data subjects.
sentences.4: Article 35 of the GDPR prescribes that a Data Protection Impact Assessment shall be conducted by a controller where a type of data processing, in particular using new technologies, is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of individuals.
sentences.5: Article 35 of the General Data Protection Regulation ("GDPR") prescribes that a Data Protection Impact Assessment ("DPIA") shall be conducted by a controller where a type of data processing, in particular using new technologies, is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of individuals.
sentences.6: GDPR Article 35(3) states that DPIAs are mandatory where a data controller performs automated decision-making based on personal data profiling.
sentences.7: These arise where a data controller performs automated decision-making based on personal data profiling, large scale processing of special categories of data or systematic monitoring of publicly accessible areas on a large scale.
sentences.8: These arise where a data controller performs automated decision-making based on personal data profiling, large scale processing of special categories of data or systematic monitoring of publicly accessible areas on a large scale.
